idea-plugin.name: Maven Settings Templates
idea-plugin.description:
Manage Maven home, user settings file and local repository as reusable templates, and apply them to projects automatically.

If you work on projects for different companies or teams, each one usually needs its own settings.xml and local repository. New clones, new git worktrees and deleted .idea folders all start with the wrong values. This plugin keeps the right ones in place.

  • Templates: Maven home (bundled Maven 3, Maven wrapper or a custom path), user settings file and local repository. Empty fields mean the IDE default; paths may contain ${user.home}.
  • Folder rules: every project under a folder uses its template. The deepest matching folder wins.
  • Default template for projects that match no rule, and per-project overrides.
  • Applied when a project opens, including new clones and git worktrees.
  • Drift notifications when a project's Maven settings no longer match its template, with Restore, Save as project custom and Ignore.

Configure it under Settings | Build, Execution, Deployment | Build Tools | Maven | Settings Templates.
